title: TXNM Energy Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock
summary: TXNM Energy, Inc. ("TXNM Energy") (NYSE: TXNM) announced today that it has priced an underwritten public offering of 7,079,646 shares of its common stock, no par value, at a public offering price of $56.50 per share for approximate gross proceeds of approximately $400 million, before deducting the underwriting discount and estimated offering expenses payable by TXNM Energy.

title: TXNM Energy Announces Public Offering of Common Stock
summary: TXNM Energy, Inc. ("TXNM Energy") (NYSE: TXNM) announced today the commencement of an underwritten public offering of $400.0 million of shares of its common stock, no par value. All of the shares are being offered by TXNM Energy. The proposed offering is subject to market and other conditions, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the proposed offering may be completed, or as to the actual size or terms of the offering.

title: Public Service Company of New Mexico Declares Preferred Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of Public Service Company of New Mexico, a subsidiary of TXNM Energy (NYSE: TXNM), declared the regular quarterly dividend of $1.145 per share on the 4.58 percent series of cumulative preferred stock. The preferred stock dividend is payable October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business September 30, 2026.
